decisions.statement: The three feeds are read together and handed over as one reading.
A feed that answered nothing leaves the activity as it was.
A reading that never came is thrown rather than passed over in silence.
A throw here is caught where every other client fault is, and reported.
A reading is handed over when the app comes forward as well as at sign-in.
The shape a reading is handed over in is the shape a pushed reading has.
The token the activity is pushed at is posted as soon as the activity has one.
A token that rotates is posted again, since the activity says so again.

definition: the thirteen stoplights handed to the live activity as the shell comes forward
